text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Kita-san!! Since you love 
festivals so much, Kita-san, I went ahead 
and prepared a whole festival as your 
present!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Thank you so much! ...Wait, a 
festival is my present?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a Bakushin-style Kita-san 
birthday festival that I came up with!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Portable shrines!! Festival music!! 
Matching happi coats!! The shopping 
district folks even set up food stalls and 
are eagerly awaiting your arrival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whaat! S-So many...! I'm happy, but are 
you really sure it's okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—It seems Kita-san has a mysterious power 
that makes people want to go out of their 
way to do things for her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Thanks to that, everyone was in 
a huge fuss trying to be the one who'd 
make Kita-san the happiest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
HOWEVER! The one to bring her the greatest 
joy shall be me! With my signature 
Bakushin-style portable shrine carry, I 
shall leave Kita-san thoroughly 
astonished!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Bakushin O-san, thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Since I received such a warm and 
delightful present, I'll have to enjoy it 
to the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that's the spirit! Now then, let 
us be off! First one aboard the portable 
shrine, Bakushin Bakushiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'm not handing over the lead 
spot! I'll show you the true spirit of a 
festival girl!
